_what: What release 21 of the RETIRED web app needs from keyguard.scad.
_why: The old address (volksswitch.github.io/keyguard-designer-web) is frozen at release
21 until 1 August 2027, but keyguard.scad keeps moving. Stragglers who have not
saved their settings stay on that frozen app AND are still offered every new
keyguard version, because release 21 asks GitHub directly. Ken's decision,
1 Sep 2026: leave that alone rather than release the old address again.
So the risk is drift: a keyguard version that release 21 cannot drive, pulled by
a clinician we can no longer send a fix to. check-old-app-compat.mjs runs as a
preflight in the keyguard release and fails it before the push if that happens.
Release 21 is FROZEN, so this list is fixed and never needs regenerating. It was
derived on 1 Sep 2026 from the live copy at the old address, not from the local
working copy (which is 24 commits ahead and will never ship).
_severity: 'required' fails the release. 'advisory' prints a warning and continues.

parameters._note: Injected with -D on every render. A rename means the app sets nothing and the render is silently wrong.

echo._note: The app sizes the screenshot plane and places the camera from this line. Losing it breaks the viewport, not just a readout.

option_values._note: Values release 21 sends or tests for by name. Other options may come and go freely — the Customizer reads them from the file.

declarations._note: The version line the updater and the console banner both read.

parameters._note: Referenced only for on-screen help text. A rename costs a hint, not a render.

echo_fields._note: Added for the by-eye editor in v87. Release 21 has no by-eye feature and ignores these; listed so their loss is not mistaken for a break.
